caption:
They rang three contractors. You were one of them.

Here is what actually decided it, and it was probably not your price.

The first quote to land sets the reference point. Everything after it gets measured against that number, and the person who sent it is already the one they are talking to.

The second one has to be better on something to be worth the hassle of switching.

The third arrives four days later, after they have made up their mind. It gets opened, glanced at, and closed. That quote was never in the running, no matter what was on it.

So the question is not whether your pricing is competitive. It is whether you are ever the first one back, on a day when you were already booked solid and quoting was the fourth thing on the list.
